Dequantize Alpha Earth Foundations (AEF) embedding codes

Source: R/dequant.R
dequant_aef.Rd

The AEF int8 decode: sign(x) * (x / 127.5)^2. Per value, nonlinear and sign-preserving, mapping the code range -127..127 to roughly [-1, 1]. Pass it as the dequant argument of a5_read_raster() (and the Arrow / Parquet variants) so codes are decoded per pixel before aggregation; a nonlinear decode does not commute with the mean, so decoding aggregated codes gives biased values.

Usage

dequant_aef(x)

Arguments

x

Raw integer codes (numeric vector).

Value

The decoded values, same length as x.

Examples

dequant_aef(c(-127, 0, 64, 127))
#> [1] -0.9921722  0.0000000  0.2519646  0.9921722
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  emb <- a5_read_raster(src, resolution = 14L, dequant = dequant_aef)
} # }
